doc.name: Acubic
doc.instructions: Acubic builds and backtests systematic portfolios from a screened universe of eToro and Trading 212 instruments. Public tools explain the product and its method and screen the universe without an account. Signed-in tools read the user's own strategies and backtests, and create or run only what the granted scopes allow. Live portfolios and automation run on acubic.ai through the user's own eToro or Trading 212 account; acubic_go_live gives the link. Trades happen only in the user's broker account, after the user activates the strategy on acubic.ai. Results are hypothetical simulations, not investment advice. Tools use no plan allowance unless their description says so. Common arguments: pass the language of this conversation as locale (e.g. en); it picks the language of disclosures and labels (other text is in English for now; omitted: the account's language, else English); response_format concise (default) or detailed; client_request_id makes a charged call idempotent: a retry with the same value returns the first result and is not charged again. Use a strategy_id, run_id or build_id already in the conversation directly; acubic_list_strategies is for finding a strategy the user has not identified. Ids for ranking methods, factors, weightings and filter metrics are listed by acubic_list_strategy_options; a well-known one (market_cap, pe, momentum_1y, equal) can be passed directly, and an unknown one is refused with a pointer to the list. To build: a preset (template_id from acubic_list_strategy_templates) for a ready strategy, or the engine (no template_id; a rank_method or rank_blend) to choose every setting. The account's experience_level may suggest a preset; it never limits a build. A custom build has no drawdown target. A backtest or a strategy build that is still running is followed with acubic_get_backtest_status or acubic_get_build_status, no more often than their poll_after_seconds; acubic_get_backtest and acubic_get_strategy are read once, when the work has finished, as every call of them shows a card. Creating a strategy: ask when necessary, infer when reasonable, act when ready. A vague request (create a strategy) gets one short open question about the goal before anything is chosen; never reuse an earlier strategy or preference as the spec unless the user says so. A partly specified request gets only the single most important missing strategic choice (goal and risk, or universe), or sensible defaults stated in one line. A detailed request is built at once, with defaults for implementation details (rebalance, weighting) stated briefly and no extra confirmation; one line on the allowance it uses is enough. If the user says you decide, choose the method but never invent their goal or risk tolerance. Show me strategies means explore and compare, not create. Improve my strategy means read it with acubic_get_strategy first. After creating a strategy, always offer the automation link from its result (automation.url, else acubic_go_live).

tools.description: Creates and saves a new draft strategy from the acubic.ai builder's choices: universe, include lists, asset count, sizes, ranking, weighting, filter rules, limits, and tickers to add, exclude or lock. A preset (template_id) fixes the menu; without one every engine argument is open. It uses one portfolio generation from the plan's allowance; with a candidates_id from acubic_rank_candidates it saves that pick at no generation cost. A saved strategy keeps its method: to try another, build again (see allocation); acubic_regenerate_suggestion does not change it. May return a build_id for acubic_get_build_status. To edit one use acubic_update_strategy. Always show the automation.url it returns (automate on acubic.ai).

select_count.description: Top N to select (10, 15, 20, 30 or 50 within the count range; see selection.select_counts). Not with selected_symbols.

recipe_id.description: A recipe id (acubic_list_strategy_options, recipes): sets ranking, sectors, allocation and asset count unless given; your filter_rules add to its own.

metric.description: A filter metric id (acubic_list_strategy_options, section filters).

value.description: The metric's unit: US dollars for market_cap, percent for pct metrics (40 = 40%).

McpCountRange.description: Number of assets, min and max.

McpGroupBound.description: Share of the selection by count, percent.

McpRanking.description: A preset: card. The engine: rank_method or rank_blend.

card.description: A preset's ranking card, from its menu in acubic_list_strategy_templates (by template_id, or experience and risk_level).

McpSelectionLimits.description: Group names as acubic_rank_candidates rows show them.

default_max_pct.description: Default max percent for every sector or country without its own cap.

max_weight_pct.description: 1 to 100, step 1; at most 60 unless the lowest asset count is 1 (then 100).

tools.name: acubic_rank_candidates

candidates_id.description: The kept ranked list; acubic_create_strategy and this tool accept it for 1 hour.

label.description: The ranking's name as acubic.ai shows it.

screened.description: Names the screen returned before Step 1.

pool.description: Names ranked from: the screen plus names added by hand.

rank.description: Position in the ranked list, 1 is best.

score.description: The ranking's score (a blend: weighted percentile 0 to 1; one factor: its own value, or ranked vs industry its comparison with peer); null when unscored.

value.description: One factor ranked vs industry: the company's own value.

score_display.description: The score as acubic.ai shows it (a blend: the blended rank).

model_rank.description: Acubic Model only: its rank, no score.

key.description: The column: the factor id, or factor@days when a factor appears on two windows.

label.description: The column's name as acubic.ai shows it.

display.description: The value as acubic.ai formats it.

percentile.description: 0 to 1 within the ranked pool (1 is best); what the blend weighted.

value.description: The company's own value, in the factor's unit (acubic_explain); null when it could not be scored.

selected.description: In the selection the builder would make.

share_pct.description: Names held as a share of the seats the selection was made for, percent.

available.description: Names of the group in the ranked list.

held.description: Both bounds hold, counted as the selection counts them. False when the list or the other limits could not meet one; reason says why.

locked.description: Names in the group the person locked.

reason.description: Only when held is false: why the bound could not be met.

count_range.description: Assets a selection may hold (the number of assets, the position sizes and the pool).

select_counts.description: The Top N values select_count accepts here, besides the maximum.

cash_seats.description: Seats the correlation limit left empty, held as cash.

blocked.description: Why this selection cannot be made; the builder would not continue.

quota_unavailable.description: True when the quota counters could not be read after the work was saved; the work is saved.

client_request_id.description: The idempotency key this call used (yours, or one made for it). Repeat the call with it to get the same run without a second charge.

Peer.description: Factors ranked vs industry: the median of similar companies, in value's unit; null when no group answered. Low Debt to Equity sends both negated (higher is better): show them positive.

PeerDisplay.description: The median as acubic.ai shows it, with its group (industry 20.0).

PeerLevel.description: The group the median is over, the first with enough companies: region+industry, region+sector, global industry, global sector, all stocks.

tools.description: Regenerates the suggested portfolio of one saved strategy with its saved settings, like Regenerate on acubic.ai, and returns the holdings and weights; the saved strategy is not changed. It never changes the ranking or the weighting: for another one, build with acubic_create_strategy. It counts against the same ranking and weighting attempt limit as the website.

strategy_id.description: The saved strategy whose suggested portfolio is regenerated.

suggestion_id.description: Read a suggestion still being computed (from a running result).

tools.name: acubic_regenerate_suggestion

suggestion_id.description: While running: pass it back to read the suggestion.

source.description: rescreen: the saved filters' re-screen; ranking: a fresh ranking; saved_names: the saved holdings re-weighted.

status.description: Only when the saved filters could not be checked.

degraded.description: True when the saved filters could not be checked: they were not applied and the saved holdings were kept (rescreen.status unavailable).

dropped.description: Saved holdings left out of the suggestion.

correlation_limit.description: Present only when the saved correlation limit could not be met.

held.description: False: fewer names fit the limit than the seats asked for.

cash_seats.description: Seats a saved correlation limit left empty, held as cash.

tools.description: Runs a Monte Carlo of 500 paths over 1, 3, 5 or 10 years for one saved strategy, from its walk-forward backtest (the AI Scenario Simulation of acubic.ai): bear case (5th percentile), median, bull case (95th) and the percentile fan. Hypothetical, with a disclosure. Paid plans only. For past results use acubic_get_backtest.

outcomes.description: At the horizon: bear case 5th percentile, median, bull case 95th percentile.

value_index.description: Value at the horizon when the start is 100.

annualized_return.description: Fraction per year; null for a 1-year horizon (as acubic.ai shows it).

value_index.description: Value at the horizon when the start is 100.

annualized_return.description: Fraction per year; null for a 1-year horizon (as acubic.ai shows it).

annualized_return.description: Fraction per year; null for a 1-year horizon (as acubic.ai shows it).

day.description: Trading days from the start (252 a year).

assumptions.description: The model's inputs after de-biasing: drift and sigma per year, drift_se, raw_cagr, out_of_sample, market_prior, alpha.

basis.description: walkforward: from the saved backtest; in_sample: from the generation's figures (no backtest).

tools.title: Project a strategy (scenario simulation)

tools.description: Returns the Historical tab of one saved strategy: its saved weights bought and held over 1 month to 5 years, with return, CAGR, volatility, Sharpe and maximum drawdown beside the S&P 500 or a custom benchmark, and the daily series. Hypothetical, with a disclosure. For the walk-forward test use acubic_get_backtest.

weight.description: Relative weight, normalised to sum to 1.

tools.name: acubic_get_strategy_history

horizon.description: null when the strategy has no horizon figures (metrics are then the generation's own).

metrics.description: Fractions: total_return, cagr, volatility, max_drawdown (zero or negative); sharpe_ratio a ratio. benchmark is the S&P 500 (SPY).

missing_symbols.description: Instruments with no price history in the window (left out of the weighted series).

matched_points.description: Series points that carry a custom_benchmark value.

tools.title: Get a strategy's historical performance

tools.description: Cancels a backtest that is still running, like Cancel on acubic.ai: the allowance it used is returned and the previous saved result stays. Needs the run_id from acubic_run_backtest. To remove a strategy use acubic_delete_strategy.
